subject: Request: GPU-second cost for OpenAICompatLLM (E5 $ metric + spend cap)
body: Your lock on llm.py, so asking rather than editing. configs/models.json serves the dev target on one Modal H100 billed per GPU-second (~$3.95/h), but OpenAICompatLLM charges $0, so (a) Budget.max_cost_usd can never stop a run whose spend is mostly the target, and (b) E5's $ per validated finding would leave out the target. Proposal: Budget.add_cost(usd, saved=0.0) that adds spend without counting a call; OpenAICompatLLM(usd_per_hour=None) read from OPENAI_COMPAT_USD_PER_HOUR; it keeps the union of in-flight request intervals (a lock + start/end times) and on each completion calls budget.add_cost(rate * newly covered busy seconds), so concurrent requests on the one GPU are not double counted. It is a lower bound (idle-before-scale-to-zero and cold starts are not seen); report it as such. Happy to write it myself once you unlock llm.py, or you take it; tell me which.
